query: For titanium alloys used as structural materials, formulate one hypothesis for an intervention that could increase surface hardness and wear resistance. Specify the intervention, its proposed mechanism, the expected improvement relative to the untreated alloy, the service or test conditions under which the effect should hold, prior evidence supporting the hypothesis, and a controlled experiment with clear results that would falsify it.

generation.hypothesis: Laser cladding with a Ni60 nickel-based alloy powder containing Ti, Cu, B4C, and CeO2 can increase the surface hardness and wear resistance of titanium alloys.
generation.intervention: Laser cladding with a Ni60 nickel-based alloy powder containing Ti, Cu, B4C, and CeO2
generation.conditions: Optimized process parameters, including laser power and scanning speed
generation.structural_mediator: In situ synthesis of ceramic reinforcement phases, such as TiB, TiC, and TiB2
generation.mechanism: The addition of B4C and CeO2 to the Ni60 alloy powder can refine the grain, improve the hardness and wear resistance of the cladding layer, and reduce the porosity of the cladding layer
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved surface hardness and wear resistance of the titanium alloy
generation.boundary: The effect of the intervention may be limited by the optimization of process parameters and the selection of cladding materials
generation.uncertainty: The exact mechanism of the effect of B4C and CeO2 on the microstructure and properties of the cladding layer is not fully understood

falsification_experiment.design: A controlled experiment with a factorial design, varying the content of B4C and CeO2 in the Ni60 alloy powder
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the results show no significant improvement in surface hardness and wear resistance, the hypothesis is falsified

The cladding powder material is the key factor affecting the forming and comprehensive properties of the cladding layer. The cladding materials that can improve the hardness and wear resistance of titanium alloys mainly include Ni, B, C, Cr2C3, TiC, WC, TiB, TiB2, etc. [,,,,]. Ni60 nickel-based alloy has the characteristics of good comprehensive performance, good wear resistance, and corrosion resistance, and it is a common laser cladding material for preparing wear-resistant coatings [,,]. It has strong deoxidation and self-melting effects, but in the laser cladding production process, if the process parameters are not properly set, the cladding layer is prone to cracks and pores []. Zhang [] found through research that nickel-based alloy coating is helpful to improving the surface properties of TC4 titanium alloy, but the mismatch of thermal physical properties, such as thermal expansion coefficients, may lead to cracks caused by residual thermal stress. Ceramic materials have high hardness, light weight, excellent wear resistance, and high temperature performance. Ceramic materials are combined with metal alloy coatings to prepare ceramic-metal composite coatings, which have the high hardness and wear resistance characteristics of ceramic materials and high toughness of metal materials []. There are two ways to prepare the ceramic reinforcement phase in composite coatings by laser cladding: in situ synthesis and direct addition. Direct addition of the ceramic phase leads to lower toughness and high crack sensitivity of the coating, while the ceramic reinforcement phase generated in situ by designing the cladding material composition has strong bonding with the matrix, which can improve the hardness and wear resistance of metal-based coatings []. B4C material has the lowest density of ceramic materials, only 2.52 g/cm3, and its titanium alloy can be synthesized in situ through metallurgical reaction in the process of laser cladding to form the ceramic reinforcement phase []. In this paper, the laser cladding process parameters for preparing Ni60 nickel-based alloy coating were optimized. Ni60 alloy contains two elements, Si and B, which easily react with oxygen to form borosilicate when melting and has the effect of deoxidation and slag-making []. The cladding layers prepared by laser cladding technology using Ni60 alloy powder have good toughness, corrosion resistance, and wear resistance, so it is widely used in practical production.
